theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tl_ald_closedBall_lebesgue_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (g : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g ν → ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in closedBall x s, ‖g z - g x‖ₑ ∂ν) / ν (closedBall x s)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
